summary: Every requirement and ruling has delivered work behind it. P1/P2 cover V01, V03-V08 and V15 (interfaces, Association links without init containers, published-set resolution, the three-entry hint table, AST lockstep, tests in both repos). P3 covers V09-V10 and A1. P4 covers V11-V12. P5 covers V14 (D55). The test phase proves V01/V12 on a snapshot. V02 and V13 are owed after the held HelmCharts push by Ruling Q1, so they are recorded as close-out Outstanding action A1, not a phase. The remaining close-out entries (B1-B6, Q1-Q2, S1-S4) are advisory or out of scope, none is owed by the plan, and the slice's diff left no mechanical residue.
